name: Sumida Eiji
source:
"Seems new to theatre, but held an interest in acting prior to joining the company. He applied to MANKAI company after seeing they were recruiting on their website because the costumes were rumoured to be beautiful, and when he saw them in the promotional posters they were perfectly to his taste. One of the draws of acting for him is the opportunity to wear outfits that you wouldn't ordinarily wear."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Ensemble_Cast]A3! Wiki[/url]]
